name: Chakra Power (Akashic)
body:
You can take your body’s toughness and natural resilience and use it to fuel attacks whose power exceeds mere physical strength.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Power Attack or Piranha Strike.

Benefit(s): You can invest essence into this feat. You gain an insight bonus to CMB to succeed on a bull rush, overrun, or sunder attack equal to the invested essence. You also gain an insight bonus equal to the invested essence on damage rolls made when using Power Attack or Piranha Strike.

You gain 1 point of essence.
